title: Building Food Metadata with LLM Juries
summary: DoorDash engineers developed an LLM-based system using 'jury' consensus mechanisms and multimodal AI to automatically generate and enhance food product metadata across their platform, improving consistency and scalability of catalog information.
problem_solved: Solves the challenge of generating consistent, accurate food metadata at scale across millions of restaurant menu items.
why_valuable: Enables automated, high-quality metadata creation that enhances food discovery, search relevance, and personalization for millions of users on the platform.
